files.purpose: Part A: TestR01ToR08 with the same 8 methods. test_r03 gains F1 stale-field checks on the varied consumer (statementDigestHex, vkDigestHex, mintValueCborHex, the four edited CB410 cases, and the K6 statement digest as a fifth stale literal). The docstring records the revision. All other methods are byte-identical.

Part B: TestR09ToR13 with the same 5 methods. test_r13 gains five oracle anchors and an independent 33-key expected manifest, checked with per-field subTests, exact int and False types, and a byte-exact canonical manifest equality. R09-R12 are byte-identical; two header lines record the revision.

F1 contract covering preserved invariants, a per-field oracle and basis table for all F1 fields, exact new positive and negative checks with counts, the first-r4 RED prediction, future GREEN field coverage, the wrapper and effects inventory, remaining gaps, owner decisions OD1/OD2 and gates.
Author notes covering actual identity, what changed, how each F1 finding closes, oracle derivations, RED behaviour, effects, disclosed gaps, owner decisions, and which files were read and not read.

limitations: Source-only: nothing was run, imported, compiled, AST-parsed, hashed or linted. The BLAKE2b, host statement digest and inline issue CBOR anchors, and the byte-exact manifest equality, are predictions from reading; an anchor defect would show as an R13 failure at GREEN without involving R4 output.
Byte counts and SHA-256 of the new part files were not computed; root must pin them before assembly.
The four API-unrestated fields (compiledValidatorTitle, scriptHexFile, scriptCompiledBytes, scriptInnerFlatBytes) are pinned to legacy main() values pending owner decision OD1.

vkDigestHex, vkBytes, proofBytes, issueCborHex and proofHexSha256 are only checked against the genuine K6/K2 values; detecting hardcoded genuine constants would need new VK or proof data, which is excluded.
Varied-export inputs[] semantics are not asserted pending owner decision OD2.
No mutation testing or execution establishes the kill power of each new check.
The earlier ordinary RED observation is for the old test bytes only; a fresh combined-source, effects and R00 audit and any new RED decision must follow these changed bytes.
Same provider as the prefix and part authors; author work, not a review or adoption vote; two fresh agreeing non-author votes still required.

Not in the packet and not read: the B9 and HIST-09 bodies, the CP r2 contract/API, DOWNSTREAM adoption, Part C contract/notes, prefix notes, the R3 historical test, the SOL files, the RED envelope and the meaningfulness acceptance.

No Groth16, curve, VK-profile, Rust-acceptance, ledger, fee or UTxO claims are made; all 20 UTxO families, full finance, ACTUS, DeFi, PCD recursion, private handoff, bounded multiparent and real Preprod remain OPEN.
